missing.lib: The drop predates the vendor lib ignore fix, so the node half was never committed. rlhbot is private:true with no published tarball and no source in this tree, so it cannot be rebuilt or refetched here; only the prebuilt client half survived. Installer admission rejects the package and removes any older managed profile copy, so rlhbot stays unmounted and the sidebar-bot and group-room suites cannot run until lib is restored.
